name: CheckResourceMeasure

parameters.help_en: The resource value. This parameter is empty by default and is required only for feature resources. Valid values: 0: Not supported. 1: Supported
parameters.help_zh: 资源值，默认为空，只有是功能类资源才需要，0不支持，1支持
parameters.name: resource_value

parameters.help_en: The desired total for APP_WORKSPACE. Valid values: 0 to 100000. If this parameter is specified, it takes precedence over ResourceValue and is not added to the existing usage. For new calls, you only need to specify ResourceValue. This parameter is not used for APP or USER
parameters.help_zh: APP_WORKSPACE 可选兼容总量，范围 0..100000；提供时优先于 ResourceValue，不重复叠加已用量。新调用只需 ResourceValue；APP/USER 不使用此字段
parameters.name: desired_total

parameters.help_en: The order component parameters. If this parameter is empty, EspBizId and BizType cannot be empty
parameters.help_zh: 订单模块信息（为空时，espBizId和bizType不能为空）
parameters.name: order_component_params

parameters.help_en: The ID of the owner, such as the website ID or Alibaba Cloud user ID
parameters.help_zh: 归属ID（网站ID或阿里云用户ID）
parameters.name: belong_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the owner ID. Valid values: siteId and uid
parameters.name: belong_id_type

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The detailed reason for access denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace `%s` in the ErrMessage response parameter.
If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the DtsJobId request parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

DesiredTotal.description_en: The desired total returned only for APP_WORKSPACE. This is the target total for the current check, which is the sum of the existing usage in the saved configuration and ResourceValue. If the compatible DesiredTotal is provided, this total is used directly. The existing usage of issues is the sum of common and word-of-mouth issues in the saved configuration, and the existing usage of competitors is the number of competitors. This parameter is empty for APP and USER checks
DesiredTotal.description_zh: 仅 APP_WORKSPACE 返回：本次检查的目标总量，为已保存配置已用量加 ResourceValue；提供兼容 DesiredTotal 时直接使用该总量。问题已用量为保存配置中普通及口碑问题条数之和，竞品为竞品条数；APP、USER 检查时为空
DesiredTotal.title_en: 仅 APP_WORKSPACE 返回：本次检查的目标总量，为已保存配置已用量加 ResourceValue；提供兼容 DesiredTotal 时直接使用该总量。问题已用量为保存配置中普通及口碑问题条数之和，竞品为竞品条数；APP、USER 检查时为空。
DesiredTotal.title_zh: 仅 APP_WORKSPACE 返回：本次检查的目标总量，为已保存配置已用量加 ResourceValue；提供兼容 DesiredTotal 时直接使用该总量。问题已用量为保存配置中普通及口碑问题条数之和，竞品为竞品条数；APP、USER 检查时为空。

Limit.description_en: The limit returned only for APP_WORKSPACE quantity pre-checks. This is the maximum number of issues or competitors allowed by the current commodity edition, not the remaining quota. This parameter is empty for APP and USER checks or when the edition benefits cannot be determined
Limit.description_zh: 仅 APP_WORKSPACE 数量预检返回：当前商品版本允许的问题或竞品数量上限，不是剩余额度。APP、USER 检查或无法确定版本权益时为空
Limit.title_en: 仅 APP_WORKSPACE 数量预检返回：当前商品版本允许的问题或竞品数量上限，不是剩余额度。APP、USER 检查或无法确定版本权益时为空。

Passed.description_en: Indicates whether the check is passed

UpgradeAvailable.description_en: Indicates whether a purchasable higher edition that can accommodate the DesiredTotal exists. This parameter is true only when the capacity of the current edition is insufficient and a higher edition meets the requirements. Otherwise, this parameter is false. This parameter may be empty for APP and USER checks. This field does not indicate that an upgrade has been performed or an upgrade order has been created
UpgradeAvailable.description_zh: 是否存在足以容纳 DesiredTotal 的可购买更高版本。仅当前版本容量不足且更高版本满足要求时为 true；其他情况为 false，APP、USER 检查时可能为空。此字段不表示已升级或已创建升级订单
